artifact_status: planning + machine-readable transition registry; not production injection code
project: PRISMA Surface Visual Governor + Atmosphere Engine
plain_language_summary: La galería visual se conserva como laboratorio, pero producción consume tokens, variantes y presupuestos gobernados. Las imágenes reales siguen siendo fondo base cuando el budget lo permite.

principles.core: Maximum visual expression, but parameterized and governable. Pasado de lanza en presets, no pasado de lanza en cada screen.
principles.golden_rule: The preset can be cinematic; the route budget decides how much of it is allowed to show.
hard_limits: Never put G5/R3F/physical glass in routine dense tables.
Never put strong glow in more than one primary CTA per viewport.
Never animate background faster than the user can ignore.
Never use hydro rim on every card.
Never make the AppShell itself a hero card.
principles.our_decision: Gallery is lab. Materiality Catalog is contract. Governor is enforcement. Chart Lab is workshop. Apps are consumers.

css_custom_properties.virtue: global visual physics: colors, alpha, blur, radius, shadows, layers, z-index, preference switches
css_custom_properties.max_use: Every preset exposes tunable knobs as variables/tokens.
css_custom_properties.danger: Random local tokens create visual contraband.

tailwind_v4.virtue: fast composition and responsive/density utilities tied to tokens
tailwind_v4.max_use: Use for spacing, grid spans, states and arbitrary CSS variables; never as random color soup.
tailwind_v4.danger: Utility sprawl without recipes becomes digital confetti.

radix_ui.virtue: accessibility, focus, keyboard behavior, portals and overlay structure
radix_ui.max_use: Dialogs, tooltips, popovers, dropdowns, select, tabs, accordion, alert dialogs.
radix_ui.danger: Styling Radix without respecting focus/aria throws away the good part.

shadcn_ui.max_use: Use as structural seed, then skin with PRISMA recipes.
shadcn_ui.danger: Leaving default shadcn look unskinned breaks identity.

cva_clsx_tailwind_merge.max_use: Every major component gets material/tone/density/surface variants.
cva_clsx_tailwind_merge.danger: Manual class concatenation becomes a cursed enchilada.

motion_for_react.virtue: gesture, layout, hover, active, enter/exit and state transitions
motion_for_react.max_use: Microinteraction layer: cards, buttons, nav, command palette, drawers, tabs.
motion_for_react.danger: Long ambient timelines are better in GSAP.

gsap.virtue: choreographed timelines and long atmospheric motion
gsap.max_use: Background drift, hero intro, tours, demo mode, premium route transitions.
gsap.danger: Do not GSAP every hover, hermano.

svg_filters.virtue: cheap optical distortion and refractive rims
svg_filters.max_use: Hydro rim pseudo-elements, not text containers.
svg_filters.danger: Applying displacement to content makes text look drunk.

three_r3f_drei_postprocessing.virtue: physical glass, WebGL lighting, cinematic wow
three_r3f_drei_postprocessing.max_use: Landing, splash, chart lab wow stage, rare hero objects.
three_r3f_drei_postprocessing.danger: If it appears on CRUD, alguien se emocionó demasiado.

echarts_echarts_gl.virtue: rich operational charts and interactive data visualization
echarts_echarts_gl.max_use: Charts, insights, chart lab, visual investigations, hotspots.

tanstack_table.virtue: headless table logic with full visual control
tanstack_table.danger: Default table styling or too much glass kills readability.

react_hook_form_zod.max_use: Settings, filters, bulk actions, create/edit flows, validation contracts.
react_hook_form_zod.danger: Visual beauty cannot hide bad validation copy.

sonner.max_use: Transient success/warning/loading/error with PRISMA glass shell.
sonner.danger: Do not toast every tiny state change.

cmdk.max_use: Global launcher, route search, quick actions, entity lookup.
cmdk.danger: A command palette without ranking is a junk drawer.

vaul.max_use: Mobile/tablet bottom sheets, evidence drawers, action drawers.
vaul.danger: Desktop side panels still need desktop rhythm.

resizable_panels.max_use: Chart Lab, comparison mode, audit studios, data workspaces.
resizable_panels.danger: Resizable everything turns the app into a cockpit garage sale.

lucide_react.max_use: All component icons with strict sizing and stroke discipline.
lucide_react.danger: Icon-only navigation without tooltip/label creates mystery meat.

date_fns_day_picker.virtue: human date ranges and calendar UX
date_fns_day_picker.max_use: Filters, reports, audit and KPI date windows.
date_fns_day_picker.danger: Raw timestamps visible by default are UI crimes.

next_themes.max_use: Theme/skin switching, reduced visual intensity modes, future light/dark families.
next_themes.danger: Theme switching without component tokens causes Frankenstyles.

metadata.package: PRISMA Tablet Light Visual Preset Engine

notes: Corrected collector avoids $matches because PowerShell uses $Matches as an automatic hashtable for -match.
Tablet policy: final visual presets must be light, tactile, luminous, and not dark-dominant.

metadata.policy: Tablet final visual presets must be light, tactile, luminous, high-contrast-soft, and not dark-dominant.
metadata.artifactIntent: planning + machine-readable maps for a future injector; no runtime code was modified.

rules.expected: L0 must resolve to pearl/daylight/milk/frost background, not graphite/black dominant.
Primary and routine POS controls >= 48px min-height/min-width; WCAG floor remains 24px.
Readable contrast on all body text, critical labels, buttons, totals and rows.
At most one strong action glow per viewport.
Rim only on major shell/hero/drawer/primary selected states; not every card.
No three/R3F physical glass in POS/catalog/sales/settings CRUD.
prefers-reduced-motion freezes ambient loops and keeps static premium frame.
Technical evidence/debug panels collapsed by default.
Ticket total visible above fold at 1366x768 and compact 1024x768.
Customer/operator visible ticket line items show name, qty, unit price, line total.
Offline/stale/syncing state must be visible in human language when relevant.
Chart DOM container has explicit width/height before ECharts init.
Chart resizes on container changes, ideally via ResizeObserver or equivalent measured container handling.
Chart frame has Pregunta, Lectura rápida, Acción sugerida.
pnpm -C products/tablet/app build or project equivalent passes after injection.

rules.assert: Foreground text over background shells must remain readable.
Rain preset motion must remain subtle, ambient, and non-distracting.
Rain preset must switch to static or near-static when reduced motion is preferred.
Pearl Grey Mist v2 must read as light grey/pearl first, not blue or dark.
Crystal panels must show blur, rim, shadow and inner highlight without reducing legibility.
Ambient motion and JS tilt must degrade under prefers-reduced-motion.
Preset controls must keep touch targets at 48px minimum.
Gallery must remain scrollable and must not lock the viewport.
Each demo panel must display or map to a codex preset ID.
Tablet gallery must stay light-dominant; dark codex presets require light adapters.
Ambient and interaction motion must degrade when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
Hydro rim must be visible for examples but not treated as default for every runtime surface.
Background selector must switch visible root classes.
Backgrounds must be tested with glass panels above them.

codex_source_payload_preserved.purpose: A massive preset codex by component, layer, route family and library virtue. It is analysis/spec, not production code.

philosophy.core: Maximum visual expression, but parameterized and governable. Pasado de lanza en presets, no pasado de lanza en cada screen.
philosophy.principle: The preset can be cinematic; the route budget decides how much of it is allowed to show.
philosophy.translation: La receta puede traer turbo, alerón y luces debajo del carro; la pantalla decide si va en modo valet o modo pista.
hard_limits: Never put G5/R3F/physical glass in routine dense tables.
Never put strong glow in more than one primary CTA per viewport.
Never animate background faster than the user can ignore.
Never use hydro rim on every card.
Never make the AppShell itself a hero card.

css_custom_properties.virtue: global visual physics: colors, alpha, blur, radius, shadows, layers, z-index, preference switches
css_custom_properties.max_use: Every preset exposes tunable knobs as variables/tokens.
css_custom_properties.danger: Random local tokens create visual contraband.

tailwind_v4.virtue: fast composition and responsive/density utilities tied to tokens
tailwind_v4.max_use: Use for spacing, grid spans, states and arbitrary CSS variables; never as random color soup.
tailwind_v4.danger: Utility sprawl without recipes becomes digital confetti.

radix_ui.virtue: accessibility, focus, keyboard behavior, portals and overlay structure
radix_ui.max_use: Dialogs, tooltips, popovers, dropdowns, select, tabs, accordion, alert dialogs.
radix_ui.danger: Styling Radix without respecting focus/aria throws away the good part.

shadcn_ui.max_use: Use as structural seed, then skin with PRISMA recipes.
shadcn_ui.danger: Leaving default shadcn look unskinned breaks identity.

cva_clsx_tailwind_merge.max_use: Every major component gets material/tone/density/surface variants.
cva_clsx_tailwind_merge.danger: Manual class concatenation becomes a cursed enchilada.

motion_for_react.virtue: gesture, layout, hover, active, enter/exit and state transitions
motion_for_react.max_use: Microinteraction layer: cards, buttons, nav, command palette, drawers, tabs.
motion_for_react.danger: Long ambient timelines are better in GSAP.

gsap.virtue: choreographed timelines and long atmospheric motion
gsap.max_use: Background drift, hero intro, tours, demo mode, premium route transitions.
gsap.danger: Do not GSAP every hover, hermano.

svg_filters.virtue: cheap optical distortion and refractive rims
svg_filters.max_use: Hydro rim pseudo-elements, not text containers.
svg_filters.danger: Applying displacement to content makes text look drunk.

three_r3f_drei_postprocessing.virtue: physical glass, WebGL lighting, cinematic wow
three_r3f_drei_postprocessing.max_use: Landing, splash, chart lab wow stage, rare hero objects.
three_r3f_drei_postprocessing.danger: If it appears on CRUD, alguien se emocionó demasiado.

echarts_echarts_gl.virtue: rich operational charts and interactive data visualization
echarts_echarts_gl.max_use: Charts, insights, chart lab, visual investigations, hotspots.

tanstack_table.virtue: headless table logic with full visual control
tanstack_table.danger: Default table styling or too much glass kills readability.

react_hook_form_zod.max_use: Settings, filters, bulk actions, create/edit flows, validation contracts.
react_hook_form_zod.danger: Visual beauty cannot hide bad validation copy.

sonner.max_use: Transient success/warning/loading/error with PRISMA glass shell.
sonner.danger: Do not toast every tiny state change.

cmdk.max_use: Global launcher, route search, quick actions, entity lookup.
cmdk.danger: A command palette without ranking is a junk drawer.

vaul.max_use: Mobile/tablet bottom sheets, evidence drawers, action drawers.
vaul.danger: Desktop side panels still need desktop rhythm.

resizable_panels.max_use: Chart Lab, comparison mode, audit studios, data workspaces.
resizable_panels.danger: Resizable everything turns the app into a cockpit garage sale.

lucide_react.max_use: All component icons with strict sizing and stroke discipline.
lucide_react.danger: Icon-only navigation without tooltip/label creates mystery meat.

date_fns_day_picker.virtue: human date ranges and calendar UX
date_fns_day_picker.max_use: Filters, reports, audit and KPI date windows.
date_fns_day_picker.danger: Raw timestamps visible by default are UI crimes.

next_themes.max_use: Theme/skin switching, reduced visual intensity modes, future light/dark families.
next_themes.danger: Theme switching without component tokens causes Frankenstyles.

Add Chart Lab export and deployment constraints.

source_excerpts.ultra_parametric_core: Maximum visual expression, but parameterized and governable; the route budget decides how much of the cinematic preset is allowed.
source_excerpts.cloudglass_core: V14/Storm Vapor becomes a reusable visual engine with tokens, route budgets, background layers, glass, rim, glow, motion, reduced motion and verifiers.
source_excerpts.pc_core: PC is a Centro de Decisiones Simple: what is happening, what to do, severity, and evidence.
source_excerpts.chart_lab_core: Single Chart Workbench + ECharts Power Studio: one active chart, large canvas, left picker, right power controls, export by target.
source_excerpts.deployment_core: Chart Lab is static Cloudflare Pages; other operational surfaces use live runtime/tunnel. No-leak scanning is mandatory before public deploy.

css_custom_properties.virtue: global visual physics: colors, alpha, blur, radius, shadows, layers, z-index, preference switches
css_custom_properties.max_use: Every preset exposes tunable knobs as variables/tokens.
css_custom_properties.danger: Random local tokens create visual contraband.

tailwind_v4.virtue: fast composition and responsive/density utilities tied to tokens
tailwind_v4.max_use: Use for spacing, grid spans, states and arbitrary CSS variables; never as random color soup.
tailwind_v4.danger: Utility sprawl without recipes becomes digital confetti.

radix_ui.virtue: accessibility, focus, keyboard behavior, portals and overlay structure
radix_ui.max_use: Dialogs, tooltips, popovers, dropdowns, select, tabs, accordion, alert dialogs.
radix_ui.danger: Styling Radix without respecting focus/aria throws away the good part.

shadcn_ui.max_use: Use as structural seed, then skin with PRISMA recipes.
shadcn_ui.danger: Leaving default shadcn look unskinned breaks identity.

cva_clsx_tailwind_merge.max_use: Every major component gets material/tone/density/surface variants.
cva_clsx_tailwind_merge.danger: Manual class concatenation becomes a cursed enchilada.

motion_for_react.virtue: gesture, layout, hover, active, enter/exit and state transitions
motion_for_react.max_use: Microinteraction layer: cards, buttons, nav, command palette, drawers, tabs.
motion_for_react.danger: Long ambient timelines are better in GSAP.

gsap.virtue: choreographed timelines and long atmospheric motion
gsap.max_use: Background drift, hero intro, tours, demo mode, premium route transitions.
gsap.danger: Do not GSAP every hover, hermano.

svg_filters.virtue: cheap optical distortion and refractive rims
svg_filters.max_use: Hydro rim pseudo-elements, not text containers.
svg_filters.danger: Applying displacement to content makes text look drunk.

three_r3f_drei_postprocessing.virtue: physical glass, WebGL lighting, cinematic wow
three_r3f_drei_postprocessing.max_use: Landing, splash, chart lab wow stage, rare hero objects.
three_r3f_drei_postprocessing.danger: If it appears on CRUD, alguien se emocionó demasiado.

echarts_echarts_gl.virtue: rich operational charts and interactive data visualization
echarts_echarts_gl.max_use: Charts, insights, chart lab, visual investigations, hotspots.

tanstack_table.virtue: headless table logic with full visual control
tanstack_table.danger: Default table styling or too much glass kills readability.

react_hook_form_zod.max_use: Settings, filters, bulk actions, create/edit flows, validation contracts.
react_hook_form_zod.danger: Visual beauty cannot hide bad validation copy.

sonner.max_use: Transient success/warning/loading/error with PRISMA glass shell.
sonner.danger: Do not toast every tiny state change.

cmdk.max_use: Global launcher, route search, quick actions, entity lookup.
cmdk.danger: A command palette without ranking is a junk drawer.

vaul.max_use: Mobile/tablet bottom sheets, evidence drawers, action drawers.
vaul.danger: Desktop side panels still need desktop rhythm.

resizable_panels.max_use: Chart Lab, comparison mode, audit studios, data workspaces.
resizable_panels.danger: Resizable everything turns the app into a cockpit garage sale.

lucide_react.max_use: All component icons with strict sizing and stroke discipline.
lucide_react.danger: Icon-only navigation without tooltip/label creates mystery meat.

date_fns_day_picker.virtue: human date ranges and calendar UX
date_fns_day_picker.max_use: Filters, reports, audit and KPI date windows.
date_fns_day_picker.danger: Raw timestamps visible by default are UI crimes.

next_themes.max_use: Theme/skin switching, reduced visual intensity modes, future light/dark families.
next_themes.danger: Theme switching without component tokens causes Frankenstyles.

philosophy.core: Maximum visual expression, but parameterized and governable. Pasado de lanza en presets, no pasado de lanza en cada screen.
philosophy.principle: The preset can be cinematic; the route budget decides how much of it is allowed to show.
philosophy.translation: La receta puede traer turbo, alerón y luces debajo del carro; la pantalla decide si va en modo valet o modo pista.
hard_limits: Never put G5/R3F/physical glass in routine dense tables.
Never put strong glow in more than one primary CTA per viewport.
Never animate background faster than the user can ignore.
Never use hydro rim on every card.
Never make the AppShell itself a hero card.

copy_rules: Lo técnico se despliega bajo demanda.

rules: Canvas central grande, estable y siempre visible.
Panel derecho poderoso para visual, motion, interaction, labels, data feel y advanced.
Export por target: PC, Tablet, Mobile.

quality_gates.test: Every atmosphere image used by a route must exist in surface-atmosphere-assets.manifest.json.
No raw 4K/8K JPG may be referenced by production route bundles without generated derivatives.
Every image-backed background must mount readability scrim before UI.
No displacement, SVG distortion, Pixi filter or WebGL refraction may touch text/table/form layers.
Tablet/POS defaults must not use dark storm, high vapor or WebGL backgrounds.
Mobile must use small derivatives and no heavy displacement by default.
Every recipe with ambient motion must define reduced_motion and low_power variants.
No more than one strong N3/N4 glow per viewport unless demo/showpiece route explicitly allows it.
Hydro rim cannot appear on every card, row, input or button.
Static export for Chart Lab must pass no-leak scan before deployment.
Chart Lab exports must include target overrides for PC, Tablet and Mobile when route recipes are involved.
Technical terms visible to nontechnical users must be translated or moved to technical disclosure.
No pass status without evidence source, freshness and verifier receipt.

ultra_parametric_codex_v2_original_json.purpose: A massive preset codex by component, layer, route family and library virtue. It is analysis/spec, not production code.

philosophy.core: Maximum visual expression, but parameterized and governable. Pasado de lanza en presets, no pasado de lanza en cada screen.
philosophy.principle: The preset can be cinematic; the route budget decides how much of it is allowed to show.
philosophy.translation: La receta puede traer turbo, alerón y luces debajo del carro; la pantalla decide si va en modo valet o modo pista.
hard_limits: Never put G5/R3F/physical glass in routine dense tables.
Never put strong glow in more than one primary CTA per viewport.
Never animate background faster than the user can ignore.
Never use hydro rim on every card.
Never make the AppShell itself a hero card.

css_custom_properties.virtue: global visual physics: colors, alpha, blur, radius, shadows, layers, z-index, preference switches
css_custom_properties.max_use: Every preset exposes tunable knobs as variables/tokens.
css_custom_properties.danger: Random local tokens create visual contraband.

tailwind_v4.virtue: fast composition and responsive/density utilities tied to tokens
tailwind_v4.max_use: Use for spacing, grid spans, states and arbitrary CSS variables; never as random color soup.
tailwind_v4.danger: Utility sprawl without recipes becomes digital confetti.

radix_ui.virtue: accessibility, focus, keyboard behavior, portals and overlay structure
radix_ui.max_use: Dialogs, tooltips, popovers, dropdowns, select, tabs, accordion, alert dialogs.
radix_ui.danger: Styling Radix without respecting focus/aria throws away the good part.

shadcn_ui.max_use: Use as structural seed, then skin with PRISMA recipes.
shadcn_ui.danger: Leaving default shadcn look unskinned breaks identity.

cva_clsx_tailwind_merge.max_use: Every major component gets material/tone/density/surface variants.
cva_clsx_tailwind_merge.danger: Manual class concatenation becomes a cursed enchilada.

motion_for_react.virtue: gesture, layout, hover, active, enter/exit and state transitions
motion_for_react.max_use: Microinteraction layer: cards, buttons, nav, command palette, drawers, tabs.
motion_for_react.danger: Long ambient timelines are better in GSAP.

gsap.virtue: choreographed timelines and long atmospheric motion
gsap.max_use: Background drift, hero intro, tours, demo mode, premium route transitions.
gsap.danger: Do not GSAP every hover, hermano.

svg_filters.virtue: cheap optical distortion and refractive rims
svg_filters.max_use: Hydro rim pseudo-elements, not text containers.
svg_filters.danger: Applying displacement to content makes text look drunk.

three_r3f_drei_postprocessing.virtue: physical glass, WebGL lighting, cinematic wow
three_r3f_drei_postprocessing.max_use: Landing, splash, chart lab wow stage, rare hero objects.
three_r3f_drei_postprocessing.danger: If it appears on CRUD, alguien se emocionó demasiado.

echarts_echarts_gl.virtue: rich operational charts and interactive data visualization
echarts_echarts_gl.max_use: Charts, insights, chart lab, visual investigations, hotspots.

tanstack_table.virtue: headless table logic with full visual control
tanstack_table.danger: Default table styling or too much glass kills readability.

react_hook_form_zod.max_use: Settings, filters, bulk actions, create/edit flows, validation contracts.
react_hook_form_zod.danger: Visual beauty cannot hide bad validation copy.

sonner.max_use: Transient success/warning/loading/error with PRISMA glass shell.
sonner.danger: Do not toast every tiny state change.

cmdk.max_use: Global launcher, route search, quick actions, entity lookup.
cmdk.danger: A command palette without ranking is a junk drawer.

vaul.max_use: Mobile/tablet bottom sheets, evidence drawers, action drawers.
vaul.danger: Desktop side panels still need desktop rhythm.

resizable_panels.max_use: Chart Lab, comparison mode, audit studios, data workspaces.
resizable_panels.danger: Resizable everything turns the app into a cockpit garage sale.

lucide_react.max_use: All component icons with strict sizing and stroke discipline.
lucide_react.danger: Icon-only navigation without tooltip/label creates mystery meat.

date_fns_day_picker.virtue: human date ranges and calendar UX
date_fns_day_picker.max_use: Filters, reports, audit and KPI date windows.
date_fns_day_picker.danger: Raw timestamps visible by default are UI crimes.

next_themes.max_use: Theme/skin switching, reduced visual intensity modes, future light/dark families.
next_themes.danger: Theme switching without component tokens causes Frankenstyles.
